entities.summary: LNK is a commercial television channel operating in Lithuania. It is a free-to-air TV channel targeted at a Lithuanian audience and primarily broadcasts local entertainment, dubbed movies, lifestyle shows, and news. LNK is a television station in Europe, established in 1995. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
